title: 第7章 无处不在的卡牌
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

剑姬反手挡掉波比控制的瞬间，MaRin的心头猛地跳了一下。

这种异样的兴奋感源于这波完美到不可思议的反蹲。

身为刚拿完世界冠军的顶级职业选手，MaRin对赛场“节奏”的敏锐度远超普通观众。

在外行眼里，这或许只是一次精彩的以少打多，但在MaRin看来，整个战术链条的卡点精准得让人头皮发麻。

从猪妹故意在下半区露头，到迅速隐去行踪，再到神兵天降般出现在上路，VG的所有行动都像是被一根无形的线牵引着。

更让MaRin震惊的是，Eimy居然在那个时间点果断放弃了下半野区。

这种舍得和决断，太不符合Eimy平时的作风了。

在MaRin的印象里，这个年轻的中国打野很平庸，除了听话外一无是处。

他甚至连冲劲都没有，每次比赛只知道听Godv和PYL的指挥，如果没人指挥，那就一股脑闷头刷野，在没有任何惊喜的地方插眼排眼，打个比赛跟公务员似的。

但在刚才那套动作里，猪妹没有展现出哪怕一丁点的动摇。

露头、消失、回城、直奔上路。

整套流程行云流水，带有一种极度明确的战术目的性。

这种绝对服从于大局观的果断，比对面的野王dandy还要更dandy。

MaRin微微皱起眉头。

因为中文不好，平时队内交流主要靠翻译和几个简单的游戏术语，所以刚才麦克风里Tree具体说了什么，他其实并没听懂。

但他可以百分之百确定，这波节奏的指挥官绝对不是Eimy。

想要完成这种级别的反蹲，需要极恐怖的地图信息整合能力。

中路的推线权、豹女的刷野习惯、炮车线的刷新节点、上路兵线的推进速度，甚至还要算计进VG对LGD当前心理的微妙把握。能在瞬息万变的赛场上把这些碎片完美拼凑起来的人，哪怕在强手如云的LCK也是凤毛麟角，更不用说一个刚上场的新人。

MaRin下意识侧过头，看了一眼坐在中路的年轻人。

陈周已经回到中路接线了。

此时在大屏幕的数据栏里，他的补刀依然落后，对线期也过得异常难看。

可再次看向这个新人时，MaRin的眼神里已经没有了开赛前的审视和冷淡。

职业圈子里衡量一个选手的强弱有很多维度，有人精于对线，有人长于打团。但还有极少数的一种人，他们最让人畏惧的武器是读地图。

他们像是长了一双俯瞰全局的天空之眼，能够穿透战争迷雾，提前预知几分钟后比赛的走向。

在韩国，这种特质被称为游戏大局观。

陈周在开局这几分钟里展现出来的东西，已经完全超出了一个救火替补的范畴。

更可怕的是他展现出来的冷静。从开局主动放弃线权，到中路硬抗伤害推线，再到毫无征兆地全图调度，他的每一步都显得底气十足。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The moment Sword Lady blocked Bobby's control with her backhand, MaRin's heart skipped a beat.

This strange feeling of excitement comes from this incredibly perfect reverse squat.

As a top professional player who has just won the world championship, MaRin's sensitivity to the "rhythm" of the arena is far beyond that of ordinary spectators.

In the eyes of an outsider, this may just be a wonderful use of less to hit more, but in MaRin's view, the entire tactical chain is so precise that it makes people feel numb.

From the pig girl deliberately showing up in the lower half, to quickly disappearing, to then appearing on the top lane like a magic weapon descending from the sky, all VG's actions seem to be pulled by an invisible thread.

What shocked MaRin even more was that Eimy decisively gave up the second half of the jungle at that point in time.

This kind of willingness and determination are so inconsistent with Eimy's usual style.

In MaRin's impression, this young Chinese jungler is mediocre and has no merit except being obedient.

He doesn't even have the motivation. He only listens to the instructions of Godv and PYL in every game. If there is no one to give instructions, he will just focus on the field, inserting vignettes in places where there are no surprises, and play the game like a civil servant.

But in the set of actions just now, Pig Girl didn't show even a little bit of wavering.

Emerge, disappear, return to town, and hit the road.

The whole process is smooth and smooth, with an extremely clear tactical purpose.

This kind of decisiveness that absolutely obeys the overall situation is even more dandy than the opposite wild king dandy.

MaRin frowned slightly.

Because his Chinese is not good, communication within the team usually relies on translation and a few simple game terms, so he didn't actually understand what Tree said in the microphone just now.

But he was 100% sure that the commander of this wave of rhythm was definitely not Eimy.

To accomplish this level of anti-crouching requires extremely terrifying map information integration capabilities.

The right to push the lane in the middle lane, Leopard Girl's habit of clearing the jungle, the refresh node of the cannon lane, the advancing speed of the top lane troops, and even VG's subtle grasp of LGD's current psychology.People who can put these pieces together perfectly in the ever-changing arena are rare even in the LCK, which is full of strong players, let alone a newcomer who has just come on the scene.

MaRin subconsciously turned her head and glanced at the young man sitting in the middle.

Chen Zhou has returned to the middle lane to connect.

At this time, in the data bar on the big screen, his last hit was still lagging behind, and the laning period was also extremely ugly.

But when he looked at the newcomer again, MaRin's eyes no longer had the scrutiny and coldness before the start of the game.

In the professional circle, there are many dimensions to measure the strength of a player. Some are good at laning, while others are good at teamfighting.But there are a very small number of people whose most feared weapon is map reading.

They seem to have a pair of eyes in the sky that overlook the overall situation, able to penetrate the fog of war and predict the direction of the game a few minutes in advance.

In Korea, this trait is called big-picture perspective.

What Chen Zhou showed in the first few minutes was completely beyond the scope of a fire-fighting substitute.

What's even more frightening is the calmness he displayed.From voluntarily giving up lane rights at the start, to resisting damage in the middle and pushing the lane, to dispatching the entire map without warning, every step he took seemed confident.
